caption: The video showcases a close, largely fixed view of a beige spiky sphere resting inside a white three-petal star-shaped cradle. Metal servo housings appear at the left and right, and a bundle of multicolored wires lies at the lower left against a uniform blue background. The cradle, motors, wires, and framing remain in nearly the same positions throughout, while the sphere turns in place. Small dark markers on the ball's surface shift toward the right side of the visible face and pass out of view. A seam or parting line becomes apparent across the sphere, and its apparent orientation changes as the surface pattern rotates. The spike grid tilts and slides relative to the cradle's petals, showing continuous motion with no clear movement of the gripper itself within the view. The background and actuator positions stay nearly constant, so the visible process is confined to the rotating spiky object held within the cradle.
